title.narrative: TEAM2: Tuberculosis Elimination Among Migrants - South-Eastern Asia - Multicountry TB Asia TEAM (01-Jan-2022-31-Dec-2025)

description.narrative: Multicountry TB Asia TEAM, Tuberculosis, International Organization for Migration (IOM Asia Pacific)This program has the following goals: To reduce the burden of TB among the migrant populations of the Greater Mekong Sub-region – particularly aiming at the missing cases - and thereby reduce TB transmission, incidence and mortality among each of the participating countries. The objectives of this program are: Increase migrant sensitivity of health service provision of TB services. Improve monitoring and evaluation of TB in migrants. Develop policies and legal frameworks aimed at improved TB control in migrants. Develop, set up, and maintain partnerships, networks and multi-country frameworks
